addressed_weak_identifications.rationale: Scalar-per-event scorer/park/source terms enter every class logit equally and cancel exactly inside the per-event softmax, so they are omitted from the model formula and the flagged confounding cannot affect the fit.

notes: Future fits require the 0.5.0 geometry-v2-global-side dataset; existing frozen artifacts remain bound to prior dataset versions. Expected blocking findings are intrinsic corpus characteristics reviewed in the wave-1 P2.3 review. dominant_single_scorer_park_team: whole eras have a single official scorer per park/team, so some scorer-park pairs are fully confounded by construction. no_connected_component_for_effect: each game carries exactly one source family, so no connected component can link source families. category_absent_in_train_present_in_test: game-hash holdout folds are not era-stratified, so categories confined to early eras (parks, scorers) can be absent from train while present in test.
